unexpected.title: OXESpace hit an unexpected error
unexpected.message: Something went wrong in the background.
unexpected.detail: Your terminals and agents may still be running, but OXESpace can no longer guarantee them. Restart to continue safely. Diagnostics can be exported from Settings > Diagnostics.

rendererGone.title: OXESpace stopped responding
rendererGone.detail: Your terminals and agents are still running. Restart OXESpace to bring the interface back; diagnostics can be exported from Settings > Diagnostics.

quarantine.changed: The description or inputs of {{tools}} changed after you trusted it.

signIn.waiting: Waiting for you to sign in in the browser…

server.quarantined: Quarantined: it changed after you trusted it. Review it and trust it again to use it.
server.untrusted: Not trusted yet. Review its command and trust it before testing.

request.notPending: This request was already answered, cancelled or expired.
request.staleGeneration: The conversation restarted since this request was shown. Open it to see what is waiting now.
request.alreadyResponding: An answer to this request is already being sent.

commands.configure: Configure the provider in Agent Settings and use Refresh commands to try again.
commands.busy: Command discovery is busy. Use Refresh commands to try again.
commands.claudeFailed: Could not load Claude commands. Check the CLI in Agent Settings and use Refresh commands to try again.
commands.codexFailed: Could not load Codex skills. Check the CLI in Agent Settings and use Refresh commands to try again.

capability.readOnly: Turned off by this conversation’s read-only tool policy.
capability.mcpReadOnly: Limited by this conversation’s read-only policy: OXESpace lookups only, no MCP servers of your own.

observe.unsupported: No connected provider can report this conversation’s state. The outcome is still unconfirmed.
observe.changed: The provider’s state changed during recovery. The conversation here was kept; check again.

queue.deliveryUnconfirmed: Delivery of this message could not be confirmed.

worktree.exists: A worktree for {{issue}} already exists at {{path}}.

cleanup.notRemovable: This is not a removable worktree of this repository.

cli.missing: GitHub CLI not found. Install it from https://cli.github.com/ and run gh auth login.

base.unresolved: Base “{{base}}” could not be resolved and the repository has no commits.

status.unreadable: Could not read the output of oxe status.

dashboard.timeout: The dashboard did not respond in time.

memory.unavailable: Project memory is temporarily unavailable. Agents keep working.
memory.runtimeUnavailable: Memory credentials or runtime are unavailable.

edit.readOnly: This connection is read-only. Turn read-only off to edit data.
edit.notTable: Only tables can be edited, not views or foreign tables.
edit.noKey: This table has no primary key or unique NOT NULL index, so a row cannot be identified safely.

network.notFound: The host name was not found. Check the URL and the connection.
network.refused: The connection was refused: nothing is listening at that address and port.
network.reset: The server closed the connection before answering.
network.lookupFailed: The host name could not be looked up right now.

send.invalidUrl: The URL is not valid. It needs a scheme, such as https://example.com/path
send.scheme: Only http and https URLs can be sent.
send.bodyNotAllowed: {{method}} cannot carry a body. Change the method or clear the body.
send.bodyTooLarge: The body is larger than 5 MB.
send.tls: The server's certificate was not accepted ({{code}}). OxePost always verifies certificates: trust the certificate on this computer or use the address it was issued for.
